title: Create a Library Management System where admin can add books, issue and return b
prompt: Create a Library Management System where admin can add books, issue and return books, students can search books and view issued books. Include login system and fine calculation for late returns. Provide complete code.
requirements:
## Functional Requirements
- Admin can add books, issue, and return books.
- Students can search for books and view their issued books.
- Include login system for both admin and students.
- Calculate fines for late book returns.

## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance: Support quick search and issue/return operations.
- Security: Ensure data integrity and protect user credentials.
- Usability: Provide an intuitive interface for easy navigation and use.

## Actors
- Admin
- Students

## Modules
- Book Management
- User Authentication
- Fine Calculation
- Search and Issue/Return Books

files.content:
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy
from backend.config import SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI

db = SQLAlchemy()

class User(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    username = db.Column(db.String(80), unique=True, nullable=False)
    password = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False)

class Book(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    title = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False)
    author = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False)

class Fine(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    user_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('user.id'), nullable=False)
    book_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('book.id'), nullable=False)
    amount = db.Column(db.Float, nullable=False)

class SearchResult(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    user_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('user.id'), nullable=False)
    book_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('book.id'), nullable=False)
    title = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False)
    author = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False)
    issued_date = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=False)
    due_date = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=False)

files.content:
from flask import Blueprint, jsonify, request
from backend.models import db, User, Book, Fine, SearchResult
from backend import app

routes = Blueprint('routes', __name__)

@routes.route('/users', methods=['POST'])
def create_user():
    data = request.get_json()
    user = User(username=data['username'], password=data['password'])
    db.session.add(user)
    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify({'message': 'User created successfully'}), 201

@routes.route('/books', methods=['POST'])
def create_book():
    data = request.get_json()
    book = Book(title=data['title'], author=data['author'])
    db.session.add(book)
    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify({'message': 'Book created successfully'}), 201

@routes.route('/fines', methods=['POST'])
def create_fine():
    data = request.get_json()
    fine = Fine(user_id=data['user_id'], book_id=data['book_id'], amount=data['amount'])
    db.session.add(fine)
    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify({'message': 'Fine created successfully'}), 201

@routes.route('/search_results', methods=['POST'])
def create_search_result():
    data = request.get_json()
    search_result = SearchResult(user_id=data['user_id'], book_id=data['book_id'], title=data['title'], author=data['author'], issued_date=data['issued_date'], due_date=data['due_date'])
    db.session.add(search_result)
    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify({'message': 'Search result created successfully'}), 201
